name: Ojou-sama o Iinari ni Suru Game
original_name: お嬢様をいいなりにするゲーム
source:
Kazuya is a high school student. But, Emiri, his classmate, uses him as a "tool" because when his parents passed away three years ago, Emiri's parents offered to take care of Kazuya and Chika, his younger sister, and Kazuya gratefully accepted it. His life is now full of chores. One day, he finds her secret by chance. "Emiri....it's my turn to give you orders...."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071111134730/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_45/products_id/8051]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation: Kazuya是一名高中生。但他的同学Emiri一直把他当作"工具人"使唤——三年前他的父母去世后，Emiri的父母收留了他和妹妹千果，Kazuya对此感激不尽。如今他的生活被各种杂务填满。某天，他偶然发现了她的秘密。"Emiri……该轮到我来命令你了……"\n\n[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071111134730/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_45/products_id/8051]Himeya Shop[/url]]
